analysis.estimand: Independent second-implementation recomputation of link utilisation and packet delay decomposition on a micro deterministic scenario (8 satellites / 1 plane, explicit CSV row table, 6 packets): does every uncovered interval equal compute_delay_s and does the phase decomposition close?

planned_contrasts.estimand: Paired structural comparison of the SAME trace/seed/config differing only in execution.compute_delay_s. Tested property: every uncovered interval ('gap') in each delivered packet's timeline equals compute_delay_s exactly (per gap, not merely in sum), and independent per-link utilisation recomputation closes against the production reading. NOT an effect-size, superiority, causal or performance claim.
planned_contrasts.name: cd05_vs_control
